description: This file defines event argument classes, delegate types, and a class for handling rendering events in the PDFsharp library, specifically for text rendering customization in PDF documents.

classes.name: PrepareTextEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments for the PrepareTextEvent, carrying information about the text and font to be rendered.

classes.name: RenderTextEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments for the RenderTextEvent, providing data about glyphs and font used during text rendering.

classes.name: RenderEvents
classes.description: A class encapsulating the rendering events for a PDF document, allowing listeners to respond to text rendering process.

methods.name: OnPrepareTextEvent
methods.description: Raises the PrepareTextEvent to allow subscribers to modify or inspect text before rendering.

methods.name: OnRenderTextEvent
methods.description: Raises the RenderTextEvent during the text rendering process.
